title: Siman 411
section: Fleeing from Philosophical Inquiry and Strengthening in Faith

segments.he: מַנְהִיג הַדּוֹר יְחִידִי בָּעוֹלָם (אַז אִיךְ בִּין אֵיין מַנְהִיג) וְאֵין מַנְהִיג כָּמוֹנִי:
segments.en: (5.) And he greatly mocked the reasons for the commandments given in the Moreh Nevuchim. And he said: "How could one think of saying such empty reasons for sacrifices and incense? Are there not awesome, immense rectifications accomplished in all the worlds above above without end through the mere recitation of the incense liturgy alone? [Meaning: if, G-d forbid, their erroneous words were correct — what would be the use of reciting the incense and sacrifices?] And how could one come to say such foolishness about the reason for incense, which..."
